rules.module_of: Correspondence.module_of (the recorded owning module; Q_module_body_v1's unit)
rules.parent: the nearest enclosing module: a child's path extends its parent's by '.' (torch named_modules nesting)
rules.order: Program order of the first Call in the module's subtree
rules.group: Definition, a static with > 8 values in one (module, family) kept as a range
rules.edge: Values read: one per (consumer Call, producer Call, port)
rules.edge_words: words: the leaves the consumers' operand runs name in the producers' outputs, summed over the edge's Calls (a leaf named by two operands counts twice); bits: the same leaves at their declared widths; words_per_read = words / reads; ports: words per (consumer parameter, producer port)
rules.param_inputs: per group, per consumer parameter, the words it reads from each prescribed input (weights:<tensor>, prompt, seed, ...), summed over the group's Calls; null when no instance rows were read
rules.varying_calls: a varying group's Calls per value of its varying statics
rules.body_hash: sha256 over the body's groups in order: family, constant statics, varying static names, Call count, reads inside the body by group index, reads from outside (count), prescribed-input reads (count)
rules.subtree_hash: sha256 of [body_hash, children's subtree hashes in order]
rules.definitions: one entry per distinct specialization the groups use, down to primitives, in the codec's v0 node form (verity.ir.codec.encode_program) with fold hints: runs of >= 3 consecutive nodes of one callee, chained when each reads the one before; a varying group names its smallest and largest representative
rules.q_word_v1: verity_vllm.query.word, no recomputes: each gate and each value is computed in exactly one unit; a value read across units is committed once at serving (the Call's inputs are committed; constants and wiring are structure, never committed); outputs of <= X bits or one value of <= W bits; per group: per_call and row totals (units, gates, free gates, redundant gates: a value computed twice inside its own unit, committed interior words), classes (kind, head primitive @ activation, gates per unit, out bits, count per Call, the primitives of one unit), committed interior values; per row: taps, every committed interior value class with where serving commits it today or the kernel a new tap goes in

taps.new_tap_in: FA2 / FA3 tap build (ROW word 3, opt-in `GUARDED_MAX_TAP=1`, #95)
